input.overview: Olympus rewards repeated work on the three-target drop bank, plus left- and right-side Routes. Clear the bank twice to light 100,000 at the outlanes, three times for Bonus 2x, and four times for Bonus 3x and Extra Ball. Start a Route at either side lane, then finish at the three-target bank or the single drop target to collect the lit Bonus; complete both Routes for another Extra Ball.
input.simpleOverview: In Olympus, clear the three-target drop bank twice to light 100,000 at the outlanes, three times for Bonus 2x, and four times for Bonus 3x and Extra Ball. Start a Route at a left or right side lane, then finish at the three-target bank or single drop target to collect the lit Bonus. Complete both Routes for another Extra Ball.
input.summary: Repeat the three-target bank because its second, third, and fourth completions open increasingly valuable awards. Take either side lane when a Route is ready, then finish at the bank or single drop. Build Bonus through the standups, bank, and top lanes before cashing a Route.

quickInfo.name: Complete a Route
quickInfo.summary: Start at a side lane, then finish at the bank or single drop to collect the lit Bonus.

quickInfo.name: Double Route
quickInfo.summary: Complete both side Routes for another Extra Ball.

steps.text: Complete the three-target drop bank twice to light 100,000 at the outlanes.
Complete the bank a third time to light Bonus 2x, then a fourth time to light Bonus 3x and Extra Ball.
Build Bonus at the standup targets, three-target bank, and top lanes.
Start a Route at the left or right side lane, then finish at the three-target bank or single drop target to collect the lit Bonus.
Complete both side Routes to earn the double-Route Extra Ball.

alternatives.title: Vari-target and eject route
alternatives.when: Use this when the drop bank is not safely available.

steps.text: Shoot the vari-target for its current value; when lit it is worth 300,000.
Use the eject when lit for 50,000; its second collect during the ball lights the lower inlanes and three-target bank for 50,000.
On the last ball, check whether Special is lit at the vari-target before committing to the shot.

buildsToward.title: Bonus 3x and two Extra Ball routes

steps.text: Repeat the three-target bank through its fourth completion.
Complete both side Routes for the double-Route Extra Ball.
Use standups, top lanes, and the bank to raise the Bonus collected by a finished Route.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play, Bonus 2x and 3x behavior, Extra Ball conversion, Special conversion, and the score-threshold awards.
Test the three-target bank, single drop, both side Route lanes, vari-target, eject, top lanes, standups, lower inlanes, outlanes, and every award lamp.

playfieldReferences.label: Three-target drop bank
playfieldReferences.description: Upper bank whose repeated completions light outlane points, Bonus multipliers, and Extra Ball.

playfieldReferences.label: Single drop target
playfieldReferences.description: Route-finishing target used as an alternative to the three-target bank.

playfieldReferences.label: Left Route lane
playfieldReferences.description: Left-side lane that starts one Route.

playfieldReferences.label: Right Route lane
playfieldReferences.description: Right-side lane that starts the other Route.

playfieldReferences.label: Vari-target
playfieldReferences.description: Variable-value target that can reach 300,000 and lights Special on the last ball.

playfieldReferences.label: Eject hole
playfieldReferences.description: Hole whose second collect during a ball lights additional 50,000-point shots.
